references.text: The prophet Isaiah speaks of a servant who will suffer and give his life, which points forward to what Jesus says about losing one's life for His sake.
Luke repeats almost word-for-word what is written in Matthew about losing one's life for Jesus' sake, emphasizing the importance of this teaching.
Mark gives a parallel teaching about losing one's life for Jesus and the gospel's sake, highlighting the universality of this call.
John offers similar instruction about hating one's life in this world to keep it for eternal life, reflecting Matthew's message.
